title: Renew dynamic network configuration
summary: Request a new IP address and other dynamic configuration from the DHCP server for specified interfaces.

steps.explain: Use sudo to renew the dynamic configuration (like IP addresses) for the specified interfaces.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface to renew.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo command. To revert, you may need to restart the network service or manually set a static IP if the renewal fails.

warnings: Renewing may temporarily interrupt network connectivity while the new address is assigned.
